title: Unsupported actions/create-github-app-token runtime
summary: This release predates the action's Node.js 24 runtime. GitHub no longer provides Node.js 20 on Actions runners.

sources.title: Node 20 is no longer available in GitHub Actions

constraints: Preserve the app identifier, private key input, owner and repository scoping, and requested permissions when upgrading.

steps.title: Upgrade create-github-app-token
steps.instructions: Change the uses reference to actions/create-github-app-token@v3 or a later supported major.

steps.title: Review create-github-app-token inputs
steps.instructions: Compare configured inputs with the target release and update renamed or changed options; confirm the runner meets the release's minimum version.
